scientific_integrity: Full proof and runnable standard-library checker with replayed output included. No experimental counts are represented as proving the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact for binary forbidden contiguous factor 010 and n>=3 only; no extension to other patterns or uniqueness of optimizers. Finite checker tests n=3..12 and does not independently establish the general theorem. Possible unindexed equivalent treatments remain; no independent external scientific audit.
title: Shortest cyclic covers of all binary words avoiding \(010\)
